items.title: 3 Large Cap Value Stocks With Steady Cash Flow as Rates Stay Higher
items.summary: Higher rates are back on the agenda, inflation is sticky, and AI and geopolitics are tugging at supply chains all at once. That mix is pushing money toward large cap value stocks that look sturdier when borrowing costs climb. If you do not want potential opportunities to pass you by, this article walks through three individual stocks exposed to these macro shifts and drawn from a disciplined value-focused screener. items.title: Does Arrow Electronics Still Buy Back Enough Stock To Matter?
items.summary: Arrow Electronics (ARW) stock has gained about 50% over the past six months and then stopped. It has slipped 1.0% over the past three months and trades roughly 9% below its 52-week high. Underneath the run is a machine that pays owners whether or not the price moves: a shrinking share count. It is shrinking more slowly now, and that changes what you are buying.
